name: Resize to Megapixels
description: Scale an image so it has about this many megapixels, keeping its shape. Each side is a multiple of the step, so the size can also set an Empty Latent. The shape can drift by the rounding; nothing is cropped.

inputs.name: multiple
inputs.label: Multiple of
inputs.description: Each side is a multiple of this. 16 is the step the diffusion models work in, so the image can set a latent of the same size.
